title: CONFORMATIONAL ANALYSIS WITH LANTHANIDE SHIFT REAGENTS DIFFERENCES IN THE SOLUTION AND CRYSTAL STRUCTURE CONFORMATIONS OF A COMPOUND
abstract: Abstract                The solid and LSR-determined solution conformations of 2-benzyl-3-oxo-6-exo-(2,6-diiodo-4-methylphenoxy)-2-azabicyclo[2.2.1]heptane are substantially different. The “best” solution conformation contains a close I···H contact of 2.65 Å, in agreement with trends in the 1H chemical shifts in several similar compounds. Crystal structure data may not provide an accurate picture of the major solution conformer in cases where interconversion barriers are low.
